decisions.reason: The source counts connectors on the main board and does not change the power-board USB-C connector type, data lines, or sourcing constraints.
The aggregate main-board connector count does not alter the power-board battery connector's family, pinout, placement, mounting style, or electrical behavior.
Confirming the main board's connector inventory does not change its power-source OR-ing method, sources, or source-selection behavior.
The source gives only an aggregate JST count and general pin-count characteristic; it does not change any panel control, connector mapping, GPIO assignment, or mounting mode.
The source concerns the main-board connector inventory and does not modify the power board's dimensions, mounting holes, orientation, fit, or connector arrangement.
Mentioning one additional on-board USB-C connector does not change the established standalone-power activation condition, LDO, capacity, or powered scope.
The main-board aggregate connector count does not change the power-board J_LED_CHG connector or any charge-status circuitry.
Connector quantity and typical pin counts do not entail any change to the current ESP32 GPIO assignments.
The connector inventory statement does not change the requirement for local decoupling capacitors.
Message 334 does not address the INA219 or monitored-current coverage; the separate monitoring clarification occurs only in subsequent messages.
The main-board connector count does not change addressable-LED supply voltage, power switching, or level-shifting logic.
The connector inventory statement does not modify I2C series-resistor values, placement, purpose, or population policy.
